scripts.generate: node build/docgen.js && tsc --build src && voxgig-model model/sdk.aontu && voxgig-model test/test.aontu
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of process.argv.slice(1)) require('fs').rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })" dist dist-test node_modules yarn.lock package-lock.json
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm i && npm run build && npm test
scripts.status: node -e "require('fs').existsSync('node_modules/@voxgig/sdkgen/dist/admin/status.js') || (console.error('Install or update the .sdk dependencies to use the status report.'), process.exit(1))" && node node_modules/@voxgig/sdkgen/dist/admin/status.js ..
